headline: Florida Governor Ron DeSantis calls it creepy that Anthropic had religious leaders bless the idea that its AI chatbot is sentient.
score_reason: Pool 6 lowered by 1: remarks on Tue 6 Oct, before the 7 Oct window (stale).
importance_line: The governor's attack on AI spiritual claims and his push for an AI bill of rights affects voters and AI regulators, but it is political comment rather than a new law.
summary: Florida Politics reports that Florida Governor Ron DeSantis said on Tuesday, 6 Oct 2026, in West Palm Beach, that Anthropic having religious leaders bless the idea that its AI chatbot is sentient is 'a really creepy thing', and that an AI chatbot 'doesn’t have a soul'. His remarks follow a New York Times report of 29 Sep 2026 that Anthropic has been consulting religious scholars on whether its Claude AI could be conscious, and he used the same speech to renew his push for an AI bill of rights, which has not yet passed.
notes: Stale: event Tue 6 Oct, before 7 Oct; the summary gives the date. Florida Politics is the first reporter; the Economic Times item (7 Oct) carried no readable text here. Amodei is not named in the Florida Politics text, so the summary names only Anthropic.
